column1: # Per-reading weight overrides for the character tables.
# char<TAB>pinyin<TAB>weight   (weight may be absolute, e.g. 20000, or a percentage, e.g. 100%)
# These override the luna percentage when generating flypy_quick5/lisp_quick5.
# 參 is a 破音字: cān (participate), shēn (ginseng), cēn (參差), sān (financial 三).
# luna gives sān only 0.01%; with the tiered essay, 100% keeps it at its common-char weight.
# 數字（含大寫）：正式讀音固定 100%。
# luna 會壓低部分讀音，例如 陸 liu 6.25%、拾 shi 99.90%；
# 拉到 100% 後，打 liu / shi 時這些字仍會排在同音字前面。
